title: Error shown to the player on campaign_start: "Invalid decisionMode. Use emergent or historical."
detail: After a normal interaction on campaign_start, the app displayed an error to the player: "Invalid decisionMode. Use emergent or historical.". The action the player attempted did not complete. [FIXED 2026-08-27: decisionMode IPC validator now tolerates undefined (electron-main.cjs); army_hq chunk cycle collapsed to one chunk (vite.config.ts).]

evidence.message: Invalid decisionMode. Use emergent or historical.

title: Surface `campaign_start` renders no interactive controls

title: Clicking ADVANCE does not move the date
detail: ADVANCE was clicked at 6 Apr 1992 and the date readout was unchanged 30s later. The turn did not advance.

title: No enabled ADVANCE control on the turn surface
detail: At turn 1 (6 APR 1992) there is no clickable ADVANCE. The player cannot move the war forward. [DRIVER ARTIFACT — the surface tour left the app inside Army HQ Main Staff, which has no ADVANCE of its own. Driver now returns to the shell before advancing. Re-verify.]

title: Player faces almost no decisions across the campaign
detail: 26 decision(s) in 188 turns — 1.4 per 10 turns, against a 2 floor. The president spends most of the war pressing Advance with nothing to weigh, which is the opposite of the surface's stated premise.

title: Command Authority never spent across the whole campaign
detail: 188 turns, 2 lever attempt(s), and lifetime_spent is 0. The policy DID reach for levers and every one of them was gated shut — the presidential surface is unreachable on this path. [HARNESS DEFECT — UNCONFIRMED: the policy never attempted a CA-costing lever, so this measures the policy, not the engine. See tools/playtest/TODO.md item 5.]

title: Uncaught page error: Cannot access 'ir' before initialization
detail: The renderer threw during normal play: Cannot access 'ir' before initialization [FIXED 2026-08-27: decisionMode IPC validator now tolerates undefined (electron-main.cjs); army_hq chunk cycle collapsed to one chunk (vite.config.ts).]

title: Command Authority sitting at cap at end of campaign
detail: Ended at 100/100. Income above the cap is wasted; a resource the player cannot spend is not a constraint, it is decoration. [HARNESS DEFECT — UNCONFIRMED: the policy never attempted a CA-costing lever, so this measures the policy, not the engine. See tools/playtest/TODO.md item 5.]

title: Decision `address_to_nation_rbih` has no authored historical default

title: Operation directive rejected with a reason the player is never shown
detail: Corps arbih_1st_corps rejected a directive toward op:banja_luka:banja_luka_2 for reason "objective_unreachable". The engine computed, stored and projected this — no surface under src/ui/ reads `op_directive_rejection`, so the player spends Command Authority, gets nothing, and is told nothing.

title: Peace-plan modal offers no historical default and no per-option stakes
detail: The diplomatic peace-plan modal presents Accept / Review Later / Reject with no HISTORICAL DEFAULT marker and no dimension shifts, unlike event decisions which show both. The player cannot tell what history did or what any choice costs. Driver policy for this run: reject.
